value_numeric.description: Numeric value of the result as reported in the source. Capture the point estimate only; do not infer values from ranges or qualitative statements.

value_type.description: Representation of the reported value. Use ABSOLUTE when the result is reported as a numeric quantity or concentration. Use PERCENT only when the result is explicitly reported as a percentage or with the '%' symbol (e.g., neutrophils 62%, eosinophils 4%).

value_unit.description: Unit of measurement verbatim from the source (e.g., 'g/dL', 'ng/mL', 'mg/L', 'ug/g', 'fL', 'x10^9/L'). Do not normalize.

trend.description: Physician-documented directional trajectory of this result as stated or clearly implied in clinical narrative. Capture only explicit clinician assertions about change over time (e.g., 'hemoglobin improving', 'CRP continues to rise'). Do not infer trend from serial numeric values alone.

interp_instrument.description: Structured interpretation flag as printed on the lab report or generated by the lab instrument (e.g., 'H', 'L', 'HH', 'LL', 'A'). Capture only when an explicit flag appears in the structured result header or result table. Do not infer from numeric value alone.

interp_clinician.description: Clinician's qualitative assessment of the result as stated in clinical narrative (e.g., 'hemoglobin is low', 'CRP markedly elevated', 'potassium within normal limits'). Capture only explicit clinician assertions; do not infer from numeric value alone.

interp_llm.description: LLM best assertion of the result interpretation, synthesized from all available context: numeric value, unit, stated reference range, patient age, clinical narrative, and any implicit cues in the document. Apply general pediatric reference ranges when no explicit range is provided. This field may be populated even when interp_instrument and interp_clinician are absent. Assign NOT_INTERPRETED only when insufficient context exists to make any reasonable determination.

IronMention.description:
Serum iron. Circulating iron bound largely to transferrin. Interpreted
alongside ferritin, transferrin, TIBC, and transferrin saturation for
anemia phenotyping in IBD. Typically reported in ug/dL or umol/L. Capture
the reported value and unit verbatim; do not infer iron deficiency from the
value alone.

TransferrinSaturationMention.description:
Transferrin saturation (TSAT), computed as serum iron divided by
TIBC. Typically reported as a percentage. Low TSAT is a sensitive
marker of iron deficiency in IBD even when ferritin is elevated by
inflammation.

TransferrinSaturationMention.title: TransferrinSaturationMention

description:
Iron studies panel for anemia evaluation in pediatric IBD.
https://loinc.org/75689-0

* tibc: Total iron-binding capacity; elevated in iron deficiency, suppressed in inflammation.
* ferritin: Acute-phase reactant; interpret cautiously as iron store marker in active disease.
* transferrin: Iron transport protein; inversely tracks iron status but depressed by inflammation.
* transferrin_saturation: Ferritin/TIBC ratio; best functional indicator of iron-deficient erythropoiesis.
title: IbdIronLabPanelAnnotation
